article.title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
article.summary: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course. (Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson)
